scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types --loader ./scripts/test-loader.mjs tests/task-status.test.ts tests/task-form.test.ts tests/image-viewer.test.ts tests/task-priority.test.ts tests/auth-feedback.test.ts tests/feedback.test.ts
scripts.update-types: dotenv -e .env.staging -- sh -c "npx --yes supabase gen types typescript --project-id $SUPABASE_STAGING_REF > src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts"
scripts.dev:staging: npm run build:staging && npx wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --env prod
